saw_lines: Campers buy awnings and tents once, then check the delivery date and whether it fits their van before paying.
So a camper who scrolls past without a delivery answer or an offer moves on, and the sale is lost there.
Your site offers 10% off, yet 0 of 13 ads mention percent off, so put the offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 10% off, yet 0 of 13 ads mention percent off, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.
Your site explains how orders arrive, but 0 of 30 ads say so, leaving a buyer unsure of the wait before clicking. Film the box arriving in one video ad and name the delivery answer in the first line.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer has nothing to trust before clicking. Pick one number you can stand behind, such as a review count, and lead the next batch with it on every creative.
17 of your 30 ads are catalog ads with no fixed copy, so the feed gives a buyer no reason to stop. Add three story ads that open on a rainy pitch saved by a canopy, each linked to one product.

ads_1: Story video ads on the rainy pitch, with 10% off in line one
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Twitter and Youtube
